papers.title: Microstructure and hardness studies of Inconel 718 manufactured by selective laser melting before and after solution heat treatment
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Structural Engineering and Materials Science, University of Stavanger, N-4036 Stavanger, Norway

corresponding_authors.name: Wakshum Mekonnen Tucho
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Structural Engineering and Materials Science, University of Stavanger, N-4036 Stavanger, Norway

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Inconel 718合金的选择性激光熔化工艺与热处理，未涉及生物医学植入物或骨整合相关性能。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化制备的Inconel 718合金在固溶热处理前后的显微组织与硬度变化。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM成型Inconel 718样品，进行固溶热处理，并表征显微组织与显微硬度。
summary_zh.result: 固溶热处理导致晶粒长大和γ'相溶解，硬度降低但各向异性减少。
summary_zh.validation: 采用光学显微镜和维氏硬度测试进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and hardness evolution of selective laser melted Inconel 718 before and after solution heat treatment.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated by selective laser melting and subjected to solution heat treatment, followed by microstructural characterization and microhardness testing.
summary_en.result: Solution heat treatment led to grain growth and dissolution of γ' precipitates, reducing hardness but mitigating anisotropy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via optical microscopy and Vickers hardness measurements.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及选区激光熔化制备钛/纳米羟基磷灰石复合材料，与用户方向中的增材制造生物医用材料相关，但未直接关注应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Does not explicitly link microstructure to implant stress shielding or stiffness matching, and does not include fatigue testing or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化原位制备钛/纳米羟基磷灰石复合材料的组织与性能演变。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化工艺制备复合材料，并进行微观结构与力学性能表征。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了激光参数对相组成、硬度等性能的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD、SEM和力学测试验证微观结构与性能关系。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructural and property evolutions of titanium/nano-hydroxyapatite composites fabricated in situ by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: The composite was prepared by SLM and characterized using XRD, SEM, and mechanical testing to correlate process parameters with microstructure and properties.
summary_en.result: The laser parameters significantly influenced phase composition, hardness, and densification behavior of the composites.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural observation and mechanical property measurements including microhardness and compression tests.

papers.title: The Utility of Metal Ion Trends in Predicting Revision in Metal-on-Metal Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota

corresponding_authors.name: Rafael J. Sierra
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文是关于金属离子预测全髋关节翻修的临床研究，不涉及生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomechanical modeling, stress shielding quantification, micromotion analysis, or finite element validation; it is purely a clinical study on metal ion biomarkers for revision prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用金属离子趋势预测金属对金属全髋关节置换的翻修风险
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析金属离子水平的变化趋势
summary_zh.result: 金属离子趋势可有效预测翻修手术的需求
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者数据的回顾性验证

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether longitudinal trends in metal ion levels can predict revision in metal-on-metal total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective study analyzing serial metal ion measurements and correlating them with revision outcomes.
summary_en.result: Metal ion trends, particularly rising levels, showed predictive value for subsequent revision surgery.
summary_en.validation: Validated using clinical follow-up data from a patient cohort.
